purpose: Design a materially different writer-visible author-input representation that removes ordered event-trace leakage before any new prose generation is authorized.
working_hypothesis: The dominant failure is not insufficient anti-AI wording. Ordered or quasi-ordered event substrates remain legible to the renderer as a paragraph scaffold. A successor architecture should expose a simultaneous dramatic field of agents, pressures, relationships, information asymmetries and environmental processes without prescribing event order, reveal order or paragraph order.

required_layers: character agents with independent immediate objectives
relationship residues embedded in present behavior
terminal world-state boundary without route instructions
explicitly_absent: AI-smell diagnostic taxonomy shown to writer

acceptance_tests: Representation is materially different from Phase396/397 silent-event traces.
No field has normative sequence semantics for events or reveals.
Characters can pursue conflicting physical objectives independently of information delivery.
Relationship specificity can exist without a backstory paragraph or symbolic explanation requirement.
Environment continues independently of protagonist attention.
Terminal boundary specifies what must remain true by scene end without prescribing how to get there.
Writer is not shown evaluator diagnoses, threshold metrics, paragraph quotas or anti-AI labels.
No prose generation is performed in Phase398 design stage.
forbidden: generate fiction in the coordinator chat
run a fresh writer before the representation design is frozen and audited
repair or reuse frozen Phase397 A3
convert Phase397 blocker labels into direct writer instructions
treat more prompt prohibitions as a new architecture
authorize full-manuscript writing or span growth
next_action: No active Phase398 execution remains. Any prose experiment requires a separately authorized successor task using the frozen NS02 packet and a fresh isolated writer context.
